about_the_game:
🧬 ZOPHARION: DEMO - Do you dare to take out the monster?

Welcome to the world of Zopharion, where survival is not only a struggle against nightmares beyond the borders of reality, but also against your own humanity.

In this dark horror story, you'll meet Thoryn the true protector of the space station and Doctor Zyphar the brilliant scientist on the brink of insanity.

You are awakened by a nightmare: your brother, Doctor Zyphar, transforms into something that is no longer human, the research station is plunged into chaos.

Fortunately, it's just a nightmare, but is it really? You run out to see what's going on and find Doctor Zyphar locked in solitary confinement.

He asks for help, you don't know how he got there, but one thing is certain you must discover the truth before it's too late.

Zyphar doesn't reveal the real reason for his isolation, and his behavior is becoming increasingly disturbing.

Thoryn tries to find a way to free him, unaware that his brother harbors a terrifying secret.

Will the decision to open the isolation room prove to be a salvation or the biggest mistake?

Mysterious beings that have crawled out of the shadows attack the station.
Are they ancient inhabitants who have awakened to reclaim what was taken from them? Can Thoryn trust his own eyes, or has the station become a nightmare in which it is impossible to distinguish reality from hallucination?

And above all - can Doctor Zyphar still be saved?

Is there any hope for him?

🧠 No weapons - Your only weapons are your mind, a flashlight and a multi-purpose blaster to clear biological obstacles.

🔦 Resource management - The flashlight and blaster have limited energy. Every step must be thought through.

🧩 Environmental puzzles - Manipulate valves, terminals and systems to explore new paths.

📄 Narrative through exploration - Find notes, documents and recordings that reveal terrifying secrets of experiments.

👁️ Disturbed Perception - Experience visions and hallucinations. What is real and what is just a delusion?

🧟 Bulgota's unknown enemies - the original inhabitants of the planet - are fast, silent and deadly.

⏱️ Race against time - Restore power and decide whether to risk freeing your brother before everything collapses.

Will you be able to recognize who is the real monster?

The Zopharion virus is spreading and time is running out.

ZOPHARION: DEMO is an hour-long episode of the full survival horror science fiction game.

Take on the role of Thoryn the guardian of the space station and immerse yourself in the adventure of a virus-controlled space station where reality mixes with hallucination, and trust can be the most dangerous decision.

short_description: A plague is devastating humanity. Dr. Zyphar conducts experiments, but something has gone wrong. Locked in solitary confinement, he hides the truth. Thoryn, his brother, tries to free him, unaware of the danger. The station descends into chaos. Will you make the right choice and survive?
